newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse prices, turnover pick up.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse prices, turnover pick up.

text.p: Strong buying interest moved most Bucharest bourse average prices higher on Monday, helping an unofficial index touch a new high for the year.
"Demand clearly outran supply and there's room for further rises," a trader said. "By mid-week, a correction will occur."
Sixteen stocks gained on average quotes, 12 slipped and seven marked time. Five companies had no trade and one was halted. Late trading led most shares to a higher or flat close.
Two special deals and slightly more active trading helped turnover pick up some 3.1 billion lei to 14.7 billion. Volume was around 700,000 shares up at 3.9 million.

Indices VAB and BIG, based on average prices and market capitalisation, climbed by two and 2.19 percent respectively from last Friday, with the BIG at a 1997 high. The BIG first-tier index picked up 2.23 percent to 4,257.24 points.
The first tier stayed in demand, accounting for 80 percent of turnover. Four of the seven high-caps closed higher, two touched lower and one stayed flat.
Oltchim chemical plant had two special deals involving a total 750,000 shares worth 2.5 billion lei. It closed 50 lei stronger at 3,400 -- which was also the price for one of the special trades.
Pharmaceuticals companies Antibiotice and Terapia gained 150 lei and 200 lei respectively to close at 6,550 and 6,650, while Compa vehicle parts maker also picked up, ending 250 lei firmer at 2,400.
Arctic refrigerator maker and fertiliser maker Sofert lost 250 lei and 3,000 lei to close at 2,800 and 25,500, and Azomures fertiliser maker ended unchanged at 3,600.
Dye maker Policolor continued to be the highlight of second-tier trading, with 2.1 billion lei in turnover. It closed 250 lei higher at 6,150.
